$comment: Characters and creatures as data (docs/CHARACTERS.md, ADR 0041): rigs (bones and joints), characters (rest proportions, sockets, colour slots, parts, accessory looks, clips by role, the first-person arms), accessories, held items and animation clips. Metres; +y up, +z the way the character faces, +x its left; rotations are Euler XYZ degrees (+x pitches a bone's top toward +z, so a hanging limb swings back). Materials are names from the shared style (shared/textures, ADR 0040): a material, a palette ramp or stop ("leather.light"), a swatch ("ink"), a slot of the character or accessory, or $block (the held block's own look). Validated by `node shared/characters/gen.mjs`, which also writes this file into docs/prototypes/character-lab.html. Prototype content: the first art direction, not final.

biped.$comment: Two legs, two arms: the player (and later people).

quadruped.$comment: Four legs, a neck, ears and a two-bone tail: the wolf and the deer (and later other beasts).

wanderer.label: Wanderer: a wide hat, a pack and a bedroll

ranger.label: Ranger: a pointed hood, a cape and bracers

tinker.label: Tinker: chunky braids, a scarf and bright cuffs

wide_brim_hat.label: Wide-brimmed hat
wide_brim_hat.$comment: Hides the top hair, and with it the fringe that hangs from it ("with"); brings its own fringe and side tufts tucked under the brim, painted with the wearer's hair slot.

biped_hold.$comment: The right arm holding the hotbar's item in front, over idle or walk.

biped_sprint.$comment: Running: the chest forward, arms pumping, high knees. One foot is always near the ground (storybook, not a flight phase).

biped_slide.$comment: The sprint slide (and the steep slide): crouched low and leaning back, the lead leg out, the left arm out for balance.

biped_jump.$comment: Take-off and into the air; the fall clip takes over at the top.

biped_land.$comment: From the air to standing: the squash on touching down.

biped_climb.$comment: On a ladder (facing +z): hand over hand, knees stepping up.

biped_swim.$comment: In water: a breaststroke and a frog kick, leaning forward (the capsule stays upright).

biped_fly.$comment: Creative flight: a hover with the legs trailing.

fp_idle.$comment: First person: the arm held into view, breathing. Root is the arm's anchor offset in view space.

fp_walk.$comment: The hand's bob: two dips a loop, one loop per 4 m walked (not the legs' 1.6 m stride), so ~2.5 Hz at the 5 m/s walk (owner, 2026-10-20: the stride's rate was 2-3x too fast).

fp_sprint.$comment: A bigger bob than the walk and the arm pumping; the walk's 4 m a loop, so it bobs faster in proportion to the speed (~4 Hz at the 8 m/s run).

fp_slide.$comment: The arm swung out to the right for balance and lowered with the camera.

fp_jump.$comment: A dip on the take-off, the arm lifting with the push, then held into the air.

fp_fall.$comment: In the air: the arm raised a little, fluttering.

fp_land.$comment: Touching down: a dip, then back to the idle hold.

wolf_trot.$comment: Diagonal pairs: the left fore with the right hind, then the right fore with the left hind. The tail up and swaying, the brush a beat behind.

deer_walk.$comment: Four beats: left hind, left fore, right hind, right fore.

deer_graze.$comment: Head down to the grass, nibble, look up and listen, then down again.
